name: Largest legal frame: 65536-byte payload, length field 65537
description: MAX_PAYLOAD is 65536 (64 KiB) and the length field covers the type byte, so the largest legal length field value is 65537 (0x00010001, little-endian 01 00 01 00). Must be accepted. Payload is the two bytes 01 ff repeated 32768 times = 32768 s16le samples = 2048 ms of 16 kHz mono audio.
